summary: Verified new Bulk Provision admin button + Dual-Role switcher in navbar. All 6 backend pytest cases and all 3 UI flows PASS. Backend endpoints /api/admin/merchants/provision-all, /api/users/available-roles, /api/users/switch-role behave per spec (admin-only 403, invalid-role 403, staff get empty roles, idempotent). UI: dual-role account (qatest) sees switcher labeled 'Driver' with menu items Customer/Driver/Merchant; switching to Merchant hits POST /api/users/switch-role (200), navigates to /vendor-dashboard, label updates to 'Merchant'; switching back to Driver navigates to /driver-dashboard, label 'Driver'. Solo customer account has NO role-switcher-trigger. Admin Approvals shows both bulk buttons (account-repair-all-drivers-btn + account-provision-all-merchants-btn); clicking 'Provision all approved merchants' POSTs and returns 200 (provisioned_count=0 — already provisioned, idempotent path).

critical_code_review_comments: AdminAccountRepair.js uses manual Bearer header from localStorage.token — after cookie-migration this is the sentinel 'cookie' which the backend intentionally ignores, falling back to the session_token cookie (works only because axios.defaults.withCredentials=true). Consider dropping the manual authHeaders() for consistency.
RoleSwitcher only re-fetches available-roles when user.id/user_type change; that's fine because switchTo() calls refreshUser which updates user_type. Good.
